title: Top 10 RSI papers of 2026
description: Independent bilingual collection of the ten RSI papers listed by @omarsar0. Seven papers are full-text reprints with unabridged unofficial Chinese translations where the license allows. Three are short bilingual notes only.

recommended_pre_reading.title: The Last AI Built by Humans: Toward Genuine Recursive Self-Improvement
recommended_pre_reading.author: Yi Duan et al.
recommended_pre_reading.note: Recommended in the source post before the ten picks; not one of the ten. CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; not reprinted here.

sources.title: Meta-Harness: End-to-End Optimization of Model Harnesses
sources.author: Yoonho Lee, Roshen Nair, Qizheng Zhang, Kangwook Lee, Omar Khattab, and Chelsea Finn
sources.english_scope: Full reprint, abstract through Appendix E.
sources.chinese_scope: Unabridged unofficial translation of that text, including Appendices A-E. Not a summary.

sources.title: Exo: A Harness Architecture for Runtime Self-Improvement
sources.author: Alexander Krentsel, Sylvia Ratnasamy, Ion Stoica, Martin Casado, and Ankur Goyal
sources.english_scope: Full reprint. HTML ends during section 5.4; the rest through Appendix B is from the PDF. Table 1 body restored from the PDF.
sources.chinese_scope: Unabridged unofficial translation, including Appendices A-B and Table 1. Not a summary.

sources.title: Hyperagents
sources.author: Jenny Zhang, Bingchen Zhao, Wannan Yang, Jakob Foerster, Jeff Clune, Minqi Jiang, Sam Devlin, and Tatiana Shavrina
sources.english_scope: Full v2 reprint, abstract through Appendix F.
sources.chinese_scope: Unabridged unofficial translation of the prose through Appendix F. Not a summary.

sources.title: Harness Evolution Hits a Ceiling: When Weight Training Should Begin (structured notes)
sources.author: Yuan Tian, Bing Hu, Hao Wang, Binghang Lu, and Fang Wu
sources.english_scope: Short original notes. Not a reprint.
sources.chinese_scope: Chinese rendering of those notes. Not a translation of the paper.

sources.title: Harness-Delta Attribution: Dissecting Gains From Harness Evolution
sources.author: Wenxuan Ding, Qin Lu, Changlong Yu, Sha Li, Shuowei Jin, Xin Liu, Zhenyu Shi, and Greg Durrett
sources.english_scope: Full reprint, abstract through Appendix G.
sources.chinese_scope: Unabridged unofficial translation, including Appendices A-G. Not a summary.

sources.title: The Winner's Curse in LLM Self-Improvement Loops: Selection Noise, Lock-in, and Acceptance Rules
sources.author: Litao Hu and Yutong Tang
sources.english_scope: Full reprint, abstract through Appendix D.
sources.chinese_scope: Unabridged unofficial translation, including proofs and result tables. Not a summary.

sources.title: Who Verifies the Verifier? Co-Evolving Inspectable Graders with Self-Improving Agents
sources.author: Xing Zhang, Guanghui Wang, Yanwei Cui, Ziyuan Li, Wei Qiu, Bing Zhu, and Peiyang He
sources.english_scope: Full reprint, abstract through Appendix G. License remains CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
sources.chinese_scope: Unabridged unofficial translation under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial, share-alike). Not a summary.

sources.title: Reflections on Trusting Trust, Revisited (structured notes)
sources.author: Franziska Roesner and Tadayoshi Kohno
sources.english_scope: Short high-level notes. Not a reprint. No attack procedure.
sources.chinese_scope: Chinese rendering of those notes. Not a translation of the paper.

sources.title: Bootstrapping Conversational Recommendation Agents At Spotify (structured notes)
sources.author: Enrico Palumbo et al.
sources.english_scope: Short original notes. Not a reprint. CC BY-NC-ND forbids a translation.
sources.chinese_scope: Chinese rendering of those notes. Not a translation of the paper.

sources.title: No Second Run: Does RSI Stop at Frontier Pre-training?
sources.author: Xiaojie Cai, Jiayi Chen, Junwei Chen, Yu Chen, Sikai Cheng, Jinquan Dai, Siyuan Feng, Bin Fu, Dayuan Fu, Guosheng Gao, Qipeng Guo, Chenwei He, Zhulin Hu, Yaxing Huang, Shuomeng Jia, Mohan Jiang, Keyang Lei, Hongliang Li, Xuefeng Li, Zhaocheng Li, Jifan Lin, Pengfei Liu, Xinghan Liu, Yixiu Liu, Pengrui Lu, Siyuan Lu, Kai Lv, Tiantian Mi, Yang Nan, Yu Qiao, Yiwei Qin, Xipeng Qiu, Junhao Shi, Runzhou Shi, Jiadi Su, Bohao Tang, Hanning Wang, Keqi Wang, Pan Wang, Ran Wang, Shaojing Wang, Yishuo Wang, Zhixin Wang, Shenyu Wu, Muhang Xie, Tianze Xu, Hang Yan, Lvmanshan Ye, Hongche Yu, Junjie Yu, Lantian Zhang, Ruihang Zhang, Bin Zhao, Chenyang Zhou, Zijin Zhou, Wenhong Zhu, Zemu Zhu, Yumin Zhuang, and Haoyang Zou (alphabetical; Shanghai Innovation Institute and Xinxu AI)
